name: e6a_restart_ac2
question: Do restarts help? Experiments 1-4 showed that which region a run ends in matters more than how well it climbs. On the past runs, the best of 3 short runs beat one long run on AC1 and 32 circles, but not on AC2, where late jumps matter. A restart when a line stalls might get both.

notes.plan: the base setup; seeds 1-3 are e3_core_ac2's plan runs (the same code for this problem)
notes.plan+restart: the same, and a new line from Code Zero after 5 rounds without a gain of 1e-5 (relative)
